feedback: The app looks clean but onboarding is confusing. I was not sure why it asked for location before showing value.
Notifications are helpful, but there are too many. I need better control over what is urgent.
My subscription plan says premium, but the export feature is still locked. Billing support has not replied.
Setup took too long and I abandoned it when the verification code failed.
I love the saved templates, but editing several items one by one is slow and manual.
The sync is broken across devices. I updated my account on mobile and the web dashboard is missing the latest status.
I need visibility into which team members completed the checklist before our weekly review.
Pricing is unclear. I cannot tell whether contractors need paid seats or guest access.
I am blocked because SSO login keeps failing and our admin needs audit access before rollout.
The first screen is attractive, but I did not know what to configure first.
